items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of exemption permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 2 Dec 2025, sent by ordinary post from a Bavarian authority: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 6 Dec 2025 (this day does not shift for deemed-delivery purposes). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on Tue 6 Jan 2026. That day, Heilige Drei Könige, is a public holiday in Bayern, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline shifts to the next business day, Wed 7 Jan 2026.
